name: LP5562
description: The LP5562 component represents a Texas Instruments LP5562 4-channel (RGBW) LED driver ([datasheet](https://web.archive.org/web/20240327023921/https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/lp5562.pdf)) in ESPHome. It uses [I²C Bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/) for communication.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The I²C address of the driver. Defaults to `0x30`.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The id to use for this lp5562 component. Use this if you have multiple LP5562s connected at the same time.

config_entries.label: Logarithmic Dimming
config_entries.description: Use the chip's logarithmic brightness curve instead of a linear one, so brightness steps look even to the eye. A light on these outputs then needs `gamma_correct: 1.0`, or both curves apply. Defaults to `false`.
